handoff.summary: Implemented deterministic fail-closed Nelder-Mead-only case, evidence, portable, durable-verification, and atomic-promotion tooling, then closed the independent review's receipt-forgery findings. Every case and supplemental receipt is now campaign-bound and signed by a candidate-reviewed operator-controlled persistent-host software key; this authenticates host/operator origin and does not claim hardware or remote attestation. Exact structured program evidence, strict duplicate-free JSON, exact summary bytes, browser identity/results, full lifecycle cleanup, and the 4000-evaluation bound are enforced. Source-current enrollment verification derives each public identity directly from its installed private key and enforces the canonical key path and private permissions. The exact five-case runner passes against artifact 8abe4760d3be541fa9d86ad3af6c33eb3241d3e423fd20e4fc85393c141678eb. The production manifest remains in the one documented pending state and no final platform receipts were minted.
risks: Final sanitizer and destructive-Wasm collection deliberately requires the reviewed P8 collector scripts, which are not present at this lane's frozen base commit.
The exact Chromium identity is intentionally candidate-bound; the persistent Linux evidence host must have that reviewed browser build available before final collection.

Repository-wide pnpm test:numerics reaches an unrelated stale checked-gallery failure, and architecture:check reaches an unrelated stale optimizer-opportunity manifest; both fail-fast receipts are preserved here.
